business: Moro Coffee House, a specialty coffee shop with 70 seats in an office-and-shops complex at Prince Talal bin Mohammad Square (7th Circle), Amman, Jordan
target: People who work in, visit or pass the 7th Circle complex in Amman (office staff, shop staff, students, professionals), 18 to 45, who drink coffee most days. All money is in Jordanian dinars (JOD); wherever you see $ read it as JOD
where: Amman, Prince Talal bin Mohammad Square (7th Circle)

segments.name: Office employee working in or next to the complex
University student or young person who hangs out at cafes
Professional or manager who meets clients and friends
Staff member of a shop in the same complex

behaviours.name: Morning grab-and-go
behaviours.how: Buys one coffee on the way to work, wants it fast, usually from a chain like Qahwa BLK.

behaviours.name: Price-conscious daily drinker
behaviours.how: Drinks 1-2 coffees a day and counts every dinar; often makes Turkish or instant coffee at work for free.

behaviours.name: Evening hangout with friends
behaviours.how: Goes out after 7pm with friends, sits for 2-3 hours, cares about the vibe and seating.

behaviours.name: Laptop worker or student
behaviours.how: Needs Wi-Fi and a plug, sits for hours, orders one or two drinks.

behaviours.name: Delivery orderer
behaviours.how: Orders coffee to the office through Talabat or Careem, compares delivery fees.

behaviours.name: Trend and Instagram drinker
behaviours.how: Tries new signature and iced drinks and posts them.

behaviours.name: Reads Google reviews first
behaviours.how: Checks ratings and number of reviews before trying a new place.

objections: Qahwa BLK is right there and I already know it
3.50 JOD for a latte is a lot if I buy every day
I didn't even know there was a cafe in this complex
Only 37 reviews, I've never heard of it
I make coffee at the office for free
Delivery fees make it too expensive
Will the coffee be consistent, or just okay?
habits: you work on the 7th Circle and take a break around 11am
you have a long commute through the 7th Circle traffic
you meet friends on Thursday nights before the weekend
you study for exams in cafes with Wi-Fi
you have a 30-minute lunch break and stay near the office
you order lunch to the office on Talabat most days
